title: servers/<slug>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json

skills.description: Optional extra skills location; adds to the default skills/ scan.

description: Claude Code itself requires only `name`; this schema additionally requires description/version/author as house style, because a marketplace catalog entry needs them and the two should agree. Skills are auto-discovered from skills/ at the plugin root — the `skills` key only ADDS extra locations to that scan (verified against code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference, 2026-08-18).
